versions.changelog:
Initial release of the corpus-legal-research skill.

- Enables live research of current US law for legality, permits, zoning, licensing, compliance, and filing requirements.
- Prefers live statute search (`law.search`) over training data, always citing official law verbatim with jurisdiction.
- Not for LLC/nonprofit formation, non-US law, tax prep, or legal strategy.
- Requires network access to https://corpuslaw.us via supported connectors; no API key needed.
- Includes detailed procedures, hard rules (e.g., never collect SSNs), and clear instructions for failure cases or coverage gaps.
